lastCompletedStory.title: Add fail-closed jq-absence guard to the runtime hook + deny-without-jq test

nextStoryContext: US-001 added a fail-closed jq-absence guard to orch-agent-allowlist.sh. The guard fires after the CAM_SESSION scope gate and after payload=$(cat), before the jq extraction. Static deny JSON is emitted via printf. Templates mirror is byte-identical; embed-vendor was regenerated. Test uses a restricted PATH (jq-free, only cat symlinked) with /bin/bash absolute path. All 2083 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: PreToolUse deny contract confirmed: exit 0 + hookSpecificOutput JSON deny; non-zero exit (127) is non-blocking (spawn proceeds, fail-open). Our static printf deny guard correctly uses exit 0.
